briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent AGI race amid rising compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while governments scramble for compute controls. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments as multi-agent systems proliferate.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native tool-use chaining; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek R2 matches GPT-4o performance at 40% lower inference cost. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins with first fines issued to non-compliant developers.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped; Microsoft and Google announce joint 5GW data center cluster in Texas. TSMC reports AI chip demand outstripping supply by 3x.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese state-backed consortium before 2028?
